newsitem.title: USA: US House Republicans meet again ahead speaker vote.
newsitem.headline: US House Republicans meet again ahead speaker vote.

text.p: House republicans meet again Tuesday morning to measure support for re-electing Speaker Newt Gingrich ahead of an official vote of the whole House scheduled for around 3.00 p.m. EST (2000 GMT).
The House Republican Conference meets at 10.00 a.m. EST (1500 GMT) after a four hour meeting Monday in which Gingrich discussed with colleagues his admitted ethics violations.
Party leaders are predicting he will win re-election but the number of House republicans who have publicly declared they will not vote for Gingrich was growing.
